scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm -C apps/bibo-hosted build && pnpm build:docs
scripts.test: pnpm -C packages/bibo-api test && pnpm -C packages/bibo-cli test && pnpm -C packages/bibo-client test && pnpm -C packages/personal-agent-ui exec vitest run && pnpm -C apps/bibo-hosted test && pnpm -C apps/bibo-hosted test:self-hosted
scripts.build:hosted: pnpm build:packages && pnpm -C apps/bibo-hosted build:hosted && pnpm build:docs
scripts.smoke:client: pnpm build:hosted && pnpm -C apps/bibo-hosted exec tsx scripts/bibo-product.smoke.ts
scripts.check:hosted: pnpm -C apps/bibo-hosted exec wrangler deploy --config wrangler.hosted.toml --dry-run
scripts.deploy:site: pnpm -C apps/bibo-hosted preflight:deploy && pnpm build:site && pnpm -C apps/bibo-hosted exec wrangler deploy --config ../bibo-camera-site/wrangler.toml
scripts.build:packages: pnpm -C packages/bibo-api build && pnpm -C packages/bibo-cli build
